notes: family: auction-money (market card race + resource conversion). Game ends after the round in which a player takes their 5th Point card (6th in 2-3 player games). Point card values are printed on the cards so entered by scorer. Copper/silver coins come from the two leftmost Point cards. Caravan holds max 10 crystals. Rulebook checked is the 2024 Plan B reprint.
